description: This file contains C functions and macros related to glyph comparison, drawing, and mapping, likely used for font or glyph analysis and visualization.

methods.name: fchkneg
methods.description: Checks if a return code is negative and logs a fatal error if so.

methods.name: fchknull
methods.description: Checks if a pointer is NULL and logs a fatal error if so.

methods.name: cmpglyphs
methods.description: Compares two glyphs for equality based on metrics and bitmap data.

methods.name: resetmap
methods.description: Resets the glyph mapping display buffer.

methods.name: drawdot
methods.description: Draws a dot at specified row and column with a given value.

methods.name: drawdotg1
methods.description: Draws a dot for glyph 1 with specific character representation.

methods.name: drawdotg2
methods.description: Draws a dot for glyph 2 with specific character representation.

methods.name: drawglyf
methods.description: Draws a glyph representation on the map based on glyph metrics and bitmap.

methods.name: drawdiff
methods.description: Draws the difference between two glyphs on the map.

methods.name: printmap
methods.description: Outputs the current map buffer to a file.
